description: Looks up the e-invoicing rules for one country in a sourced dataset: B2G and B2B mandates for issuing and receiving, start dates, turnover thresholds, required formats and official sources. Use it before create_invoice to decide which format a buyer in that country needs, or to answer when a mandate applies. It says nothing about a specific invoice; use validate_invoice to check one. Covers BE, DE, ES, FR, IT, NL, PL. `conformoSupport` says per format whether this server can create, read and validate it. Entries marked unverified are not confirmed from an official source; say so. Information, not legal advice. Reads a bundled dataset; no network.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

name: get_country_requirements

outputSchema.description: The sourced country record (mandates, dates, thresholds, sources) plus conformoSupport.

generate.description: This server can create the format.

read.description: This server can read the format.

validate.description: This server can validate the format.

conformoSupport.description: Per required format, what this server can do with it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country returned.

title: E-invoicing requirements for a country
